name: Axis Trustee Services Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt restricts administrative and query paths only, and nothing found addresses automated access. The copyright notice says site materials "may not be reproduced, distributed, transmitted, displayed, or otherwise used without the prior written permission" of the company. The project publishes facts and short identifying quotations with links, relying on fair dealing for research and review; it has not sought permission.

name: Aye Finance Limited (issuer website and document host)
terms_summary: Issuer's own regulatory filings published for investors; the filing cited was addressed to BSE. No terms of use page was found on the homepage. The cloudfront host was reached from a search result for the issuer's material-event disclosures, and the filing itself is on the issuer's letterhead.

name: Beacon Trusteeship Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt publishes "Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference" and blocks named AI crawlers. Anything derived from this source is flagged ai_training_reserved in every export. No terms of use page was found on the homepage.

name: Bond Central (Online Bond Platform Providers Association, with stock exchanges and depositories)
BSE Limited
terms_summary: BSE's published disclaimer states that reproduction, redistribution or transmission of information on the website is prohibited. No clause on automated access was found and neither bseindia.com nor bond.bseindia.com serves a robots.txt, but on 2026-11-04 both hosts refused the project's identified client (an error page on bond.bseindia.com, HTTP 406 on www.bseindia.com) while serving the same files to browsers. The project treats that as an access restriction and does not disguise its client: exchange-hosted documents are downloaded in a browser and ingested by hash with `brdo add-document --from-file`.

name: Catalyst Trusteeship Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt restricts only /wp-admin/. The site prints an all-rights-reserved notice and no terms of use were found; nothing found addresses automated access. The breach status reports state that they are published "for information of Debenture Holders, Other Intermediaries and General Public". Quotations are kept short as a matter of policy.

name: Central Depository Services (India) Limited
terms_summary: Copyright policy states that no one may copy, download or store the site's content without prior written permission; CDSL does not object to direct links. Its public Corporate Bond Database pages (SEBI's centralised database for corporate bonds) are consulted one page at a time outside the pipeline and cited by link with the single value observed; nothing is stored.

name: Central Bank of India (registered debenture trustee)
Dvara Kshetriya Gramin Financial Services Private Limited (issuer website)
terms_summary: Issuer's disclosures published under regulation 62 of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The disclaimer restricts reproduction without prior written permission and allows downloads for personal non-commercial use. Only a filing the issuer made to the exchange is cited, with minimal quotation.

name: ICRA Limited
terms_summary: The rationale itself says "Contents may be used freely with due acknowledgement to ICRA". The site's robots.txt path answers with a bot-mitigation page rather than a robots file, so no robots rules could be read. If the fetcher is refused, the document is logged as inaccessible; the challenge is never worked around.

name: IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt restricts only /wp-admin/, and nothing found addresses automated access. The disclaimer says content "shall not be distributed, modified, transmitted, reused, reported or used for public or commercial purposes" without prior written permission. The project publishes facts and short identifying quotations with links, relying on fair dealing for research and review; it has not sought permission.

name: IndiaBonds (online bond platform)
terms_summary: robots.txt permits crawling, but the terms exclude "any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools to extract (whether once or many times) any parts of Platform", systematic downloading, and derivative databases. Per-ISIN pages link issue documents, which can be consulted in a browser; the pipeline does not retrieve from this platform.

name: Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited (issuer website)
terms_summary: The terms limit use of the site's content to personal, non-commercial use and forbid copying, reproduction or distribution without written authorization. They do not address automated access. The address /robots.txt returns a script fragment rather than a robots file, which the fetcher treats as no robots file. Only the issuer's own regulatory filing is cited, with short quotations.

name: MITCON Credentia Trusteeship Services Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt restricts only /cgi-bin/, and nothing found addresses automated access. The disclaimer says the data may not be reproduced or distributed "for any public or commercial purposes". The project publishes facts and short identifying quotations with links, relying on fair dealing for research and review; it has not sought permission.

name: National Securities Depository Limited
terms_summary: Hosts the Security and Covenant Monitoring System, which is accessible only to registered issuers, debenture trustees and credit rating agencies; NSDL's page describes no public view of it. The public India Bond Info portal is a single-page application and is treated as a link-only source consulted outside the pipeline.

name: National Stock Exchange of India Limited
terms_summary: Terms of use prohibit "any systematic or automated data collection activities (including scraping, data mining, data extraction and data harvesting)" and storing or republishing content without prior written permission. The hyperlinking policy requires prior written permission before third-party sites link to NSE. The project therefore neither retrieves from nor links to NSE; documents found only on NSE are logged as excluded by policy.

name: Orbis Trusteeship Services Private Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt publishes "Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference" and blocks named AI crawlers. Anything derived from this source is flagged ai_training_reserved in every export.

name: Pahal Financial Services Private Limited (issuer website)
SATYA MicroCapital Limited (issuer website)
terms_summary: The terms forbid copying, reproducing or republishing content for publication or distribution without permission, and do not address automated access; robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/. The quarterly compliance reports on the regulation 62 page also print lists of individual debenture holders, which the project never transcribes.

name: Securities and Exchange Board of India
terms_summary: Website policy allows reproduction free of charge only after permission is requested by email, accurately and not in a misleading context. robots.txt disallows only script and style paths. Circulars are cited by link with short quotations; no permission has been sought, so no circular is redistributed.

name: Vistra ITCL (India) Limited
terms_summary: robots.txt sets a crawl delay of 10 seconds, which the fetcher honours. The legal notice allows downloads for non-commercial, private use and says the contents may not be distributed, reused, reported or used "for public or commercial purposes" without written permission. The project publishes facts and short identifying quotations with links, relying on fair dealing for research and review; it has not sought permission.
